g.text: Set up by Jose: the app runs on an EC2
virtual machine, the database on Amazon RDS,
and the domain is registered with Route 53.
Still to confirm: instance type, region, nginx
vs. Spring Boot serving the frontend, HTTPS.
a node: a machine or place where software runs
an execution environment, e.g. the JVM on the server
an artifact: a deployed file, e.g. the backend jar
a network connection, labelled with what travels over it
